invariants: Program pins eligibility, earning rules and reward catalog
Awards require observed behavior, completed evaluations and accepted decision
Points use exact published ledger transfers; nonfungible benefits use Entitlement
One terminal disposition serializes whole-award redemption, expiry and reversal
Corrections create bounded new awards only after reversing predecessors
